result.title: NVIDIA Vera—The CPU for Agents
result.description:
NVIDIA Vera is a new CPU for agents, delivering 80% faster agentic task completion than x86 processors while handling the heavy CPU workloads behind modern AI factories — from reinforcement learning to data orchestration. It extends NVIDIA's AI platform from GPU to CPU, powering standalone Vera servers, Vera Rubin systems, and Vera BlueField-4 STX AI storage platforms.

Read the press release: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-unveils-vera-the-cpu-for-the-age-of-ai 

Learn more about the Vera CPU: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/vera-cpu/

result.title: Accelerating Humanoid Robot Development With NVIDIA Isaac GR00T
result.description:
General-purpose humanoid robots represent the next leap in AI, but development remains fragmented.

Developers spend significant time setting up robotics infrastructure before they can focus on core development work.

With NVIDIA Isaac™ GR00T, an open humanoid robot development platform, developers can set up simulation environments in Isaac Lab, capture human demonstrations on real or simulated robots, and generate synthetic data with NVIDIA Omniverse™ and NVIDIA Cosmos™ to cut setup time from days to hours.

The Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot, the first open humanoid robot reference design built on NVIDIA Jetson Thor™ and the Isaac GR00T platform helps research teams move faster from robot bring-up to skill development and real-world validation.

Read the Press Release: https://nvda.ws/4vlY6fi
Learn More About Isaac GR00T: https://nvda.ws/4vCPpxp
